w: Swamishri arrived in Houston and inaugurated the newly built sadhus' residence.

In the evening assembly, Swamishri was given a grand welcome by the Akshar Dhvani marching band. In his blessings, Swamishri stressed the importance of satsang in one's life, saying it benefits the individual, family, community, and country. He concluded by encouraging everyone to take advantage of the spiritual and cultural activities organised during the 14-day Mandir Mahotsav.
